notes: Refactored presentation layer handlers to reduce class coupling by extracting mapping logic into dedicated mapper classes. Removed dead code and unused usings. Both handlers improved: GetLearningComponentsHandler coupling reduced from 20 to 16 (-4), GetLearningSpaceListHandler coupling reduced from 15 to 11 (-4). Maintainability Index also improved for both handlers. Remaining YELLOW violations are inherent to ASP.NET Core handler pattern requiring service interfaces, result types, and response DTOs.
